subject: [PATCH v2 11/12] mm/collapse: declare the collapse interface in collapse.h

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch declares the collapse interface in collapse.h, making it possible to use the collapse functionality from other files. The interface includes functions for setting up and releasing a control structure, scanning and collapsing PTE tables, and revalidating VMAs after a collapse operation. This is a preparation step for implementing MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c and does not introduce any functional changes.
